$comment: Tests of the pinned bb release that fail on GitHub's runners with and without the 1ma changes, while bb's own CI passes them. Desktop bb tests still run them; a shard fails on anything not listed here. Review every entry when upstream.json moves to another bb release and set bb to that tag; see desktop/README.md.

tests.name: connect setup guide section > reports a sign-in that could not start or was denied as a sign-in failure
tests.reason: the test clicks Set up before the status has loaded, which slower runners expose; bb fixed the test after 0.49.0 (get-bb/bb#7201); fails in the baseline run 42350376395 too

tests.name: remote branch refresh > fetches and prunes only origin when other remotes exist (interactive: true)
tests.reason: Git 2.56, on GitHub's ubuntu-24.04 image, updates the remote-tracking refs of the remote whose URL a push names; the test's setup pushes to remote URLs and expects their refs untouched, which holds on the older Git of bb's runners; fails in the baseline run 42350376395 too

tests.name: remote branch refresh > fetches and prunes only origin when other remotes exist (interactive: false)
tests.reason: the same Git 2.56 push-to-URL behaviour as the interactive case

tests.name: remote branch refresh > skips repositories with several remotes and none named origin
tests.reason: the same Git 2.56 push-to-URL behaviour: the setup's pushes move refs the test expects to stay
